lock.encrypted_device: Your journal is encrypted on this device.
lock.biometric_failed: Biometric unlock failed. Please try again.
lock.forgot_password: Forgot password? Your data cannot be recovered.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.body: Enter the 24-word recovery phrase you saved when you set up this journal, then choose a new password. This works entirely on this device — no internet required.
forgot.passphrase_placeholder: Type or paste your 24 words, separated by spaces…
forgot.new_password_placeholder: Pick a new password to unlock this journal
forgot.no_recovery_slot: This device has no stored recovery phrase, so the password can't be reset here. This journal was set up before offline recovery existed.
forgot.boot_file_unrecoverable: This device's local unlock file is too damaged to repair, so this recovery phrase can't be checked here. Your encrypted journal itself is unaffected — if you use another device with this journal, that copy still works normally.
forgot.error_fallback: Couldn't reset the password. Double-check your recovery phrase and try again.

boot_file_corrupt.title: Unlock file needs repair
boot_file_corrupt.body: Memlore could not read the local unlock file on this device. Your encrypted journal is still on disk and was not deleted.
boot_file_corrupt.safe_note: Your entries are safe. Use the 24-word recovery phrase you saved when you set up this journal to restore access and set a new device password.
boot_file_corrupt.hint: This works offline on this device. Do not reinstall or create a new journal — that will not open your existing vault.

unlock_method.title: How will you unlock?
unlock_method.description: Pick how you open your journal every day. You can change this later in Settings.
unlock_method.password_note: You type your password each time you open Memlore.
unlock_method.os_note: Touch ID opens your journal. Your password is set up in the next step and still works whenever Touch ID is unavailable or cancelled.
unlock_method.unavailable_note: Touch ID is not available on this platform yet, so this device unlocks with your password.

set_password.title: Set Your Password
set_password.description: Your journal is end-to-end encrypted. Only your password can unlock it — we can't recover it if lost.
set_password.hint: Minimum {{count}} characters, this device only. <0>No password reset</0> — your 24-word recovery phrase (next step) is the only backup.

recovery.intro_body: These 24 words are the only way to recover your journal if you forget your device password, or to add this account to another device. Save them somewhere safe — they will not be shown again.
recovery.write_down_warning: Write these words down on paper or save them in a password manager. If you lose both your device password and this phrase, your encrypted journal cannot be recovered. Memlore cannot reset it.
recovery.lose_warning_modal_body: Without this phrase, lost device passwords mean lost data. There is no backdoor. Confirm you have saved the phrase before continuing.
recovery.lose_warning_modal_ack: I have written down or securely saved my recovery phrase.
recovery.confirm_body: Enter the words from your recovery phrase at the positions shown to confirm you've saved them.
recovery.mismatch_error: Those answers didn't match. Double-check your saved phrase and try again.
recovery.wrong_password: Wrong password. Please re-enter the password you set in the previous step.
recovery.resume_notice: Resuming your previous setup. Please confirm your recovery phrase.

sheet.warning: This file stores your 24 words in plain text. Anyone who opens it owns your journal — keep it offline, on paper or on a drive you control, never in a synced folder or photo library.
sheet.not_a_backup: It is a copy of the one secret you already have, not a second one. It does not make your journal safer; it only saves you from retyping the words.
sheet.error: Could not save the recovery sheet: {{message}}

encryption.intro: Your journal is end-to-end encrypted. Only you can read it.
encryption.bullet1: Entries are encrypted on your device before they are saved or synced.
encryption.bullet2: Each device can have its own password — you never share it with other devices.
encryption.bullet3: You also get 24 recovery words to add other devices or regain access.
encryption.bullet4: There is no backdoor. Lose both your password and recovery words and the journal is gone.

welcome_first_run.title: Welcome to Memlore
welcome_first_run.subtitle: Your journal is end-to-end encrypted, always.
welcome_first_run.existing_cloud_title: I already have a journal in the cloud
welcome_first_run.cloud_empty_body: {{provider}} is connected but there's no journal there yet. Create a new journal — it will be uploaded automatically.
welcome_first_run.existing_cloud_error_v1_wiped: An old vault format was cleaned up. Click Connect existing vault again to continue.
welcome_first_run.existing_cloud_error_unexpected_ready: Unexpected response from the server. Please try again.
welcome_first_run.existing_cloud_error_unsafe_setup: Internal state issue — {{provider}} is connected but this device has no journal yet. Please restart the app and try again.
welcome_first_run.existing_cloud_error_cloud_vault_exists: There's already an encrypted journal in this {{provider}}. Use "I already have a journal in the cloud" to restore it instead of creating a new one.
welcome_first_run.existing_cloud_error_pending_session_exp: Your Google sign-in expired. Please connect Google Drive again to continue.

force_re_pair.title: Re-pair this device
force_re_pair.body: Your encryption keys were updated on another device. Paste that vault's 24-word recovery phrase, then pick a new local password for this device.
force_re_pair.passphrase_label: Recovery phrase from the original vault (24 words)
force_re_pair.passphrase_placeholder: Paste the 24 words from the vault you want to join…
force_re_pair.new_password_label: New local password for this device
force_re_pair.new_password_placeholder: Pick a password to unlock the app on this device
force_re_pair.error_fallback: Re-pairing failed. Make sure you are using the recovery phrase from the vault you are joining — not a phrase generated on this device.

explainer.title: About re-pairing
explainer.which_phrase_body: Use the same 24-word phrase you saved when the vault was first created — NOT a phrase this device may have generated locally. The recovery phrase is the security boundary, not any old local password.
explainer.new_password_body: Any password you previously used on this device will be replaced by the new one you set below. It only unlocks the app on this device; the recovery phrase is what grants access to the vault.

reconnect.prompt: Google Drive disconnected on this device?
reconnect.hint: Both the vault check and re-pairing need a Google Drive session. If this device's Drive sign-in has expired, reconnect first, then re-pair (or the screen will dismiss itself if the vault turns out to be healthy).
reconnect.password_placeholder: The password you unlock this device with
reconnect.still_required: Google Drive is reconnected, but this vault still requires re-pairing. Enter the recovery phrase above.
reconnect.unexpected_outcome: Google Drive reconnected, but the cloud vault is in a state this screen can't recover from ({{outcome}}).

onboard.title: Add this device to your vault
onboard.body: {{provider}} already has an encrypted vault. Enter your 24-word recovery phrase to unlock it and set up this device.
onboard.passphrase_placeholder: Type or paste your 24 words, separated by spaces…
onboard.passphrase_wrong: Wrong recovery phrase. Check each word and try again.
onboard.vault_inconsistent: Could not verify the cloud vault. The recovery phrase may not match this vault.
onboard.set_password_title: Set a password for this device
onboard.set_password_body: Choose a password to unlock Memlore on this device. This can be different from your other devices.

reconnect_drive.title: Reconnect Google Drive
reconnect_drive.body: We couldn't verify your encryption keys — usually an expired Google Drive sign-in. Reconnect to resume syncing. Your journal is safe on this device.
reconnect_drive.still_required: Google Drive is reconnected, but your keys still couldn't be verified. Try reconnecting again.

journal.title: Name your first journal
journal.explanation: A journal groups related entries. You can create more later.
journal.color_label: Choose a color for this journal
journal.save_error: Couldn't save your journal. Please try again.

theme.title: Choose your look
theme.explanation: Pick a design system, light or dark mode and an accent color. You can change all of this anytime in Settings.

drive.title: Sync with a cloud service
drive.explanation: Back up your journal to a cloud service, end-to-end encrypted. Optional — you can set this up later in Settings.
drive.picker_hint: Choose where this journal should sync. You can skip this and set it up later in Settings.
drive.error_generic: Couldn't connect to {{provider}}. Please try again.
drive.background_hint: You can continue — we'll finish connecting in the background.
drive.background_failed: Couldn't connect to {{provider}}. You can finish setup in Settings → Cloud Provider.

ai.title: Set up AI
ai.explanation: Add AI-powered features like search, suggestions, and reflection prompts. Entirely optional — skip or configure later in Settings.
ai.provider_explanation: Local providers run on your computer — nothing leaves the device. Subscription CLIs and hosted providers both send entry text to that provider once you accept the privacy notice.
ai.embedding_explanation: Embeddings find entries by meaning, not just keywords. They're required for these features:
ai.embedding_dependent_note: Skip for now and you can set this up later in Settings — these features stay off until you do.
ai.features_explanation: Enable any of these now, or leave them off and turn them on later in Settings → AI.
ai.features_all_description: Turn every available feature on or off at once.
ai.feature_needs_embedding: Needs embedding — set it up later in Settings.
ai.feature_needs_image_model: Needs an image model — set it up later in Settings.
ai.integrated_download_notice: You can continue — the model downloads in the background. Progress shows in the footer after setup.
ai.integrated_model_ready: This model is already on this device.
ai.image_explanation: Your other device already picked an image model. Confirm the provider here and add a key if this machine needs one.

celebration.title: You're all set!
celebration.body: Welcome to Memlore. Your private journal is ready — start writing whenever you like.

setup_sync.title: You're all set!
setup_sync.body: Your journal is syncing with the cloud. It keeps running in the background — watch the sync status in the footer.

joined_sync.title: You're connected!
joined_sync.body: Your journal is downloading from the cloud. It keeps running in the background — watch the sync status in the footer.
